clue.text: Saw dog wearing lead

indicators.note: the dog wears the lead, so its letters sit inside those of lead

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for the metal lead
Rover is the stock name for a dog

explanation.surface: Someone noticed a dog with its lead on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past of see, but it is the noun: an old saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or maxim, the same thing as a proverb.

clue.text: Football legend receives 2 billion for a small stone

indicators.note: the footballer takes in the other letters, so they go inside his name

parts.note: Pele was the great Brazilian footballer
B is the abbreviation for billion, so two of them

explanation.surface: A football star is paid two billion for a mere pebble.
explanation.definitionFit: A pebble is a small smooth stone, as found on a beach.

clue.text: Respite from work, which is not going well?

definitions.text: Respite from work, which is not going well?

parts.words: Respite from work, which is not going well?
parts.note: a day off is respite from work; reversed the phrase is a day when nothing goes well

explanation.walkthrough: The clue leans on the phrase for a holiday from work, whose words swapped round give a bad day.
explanation.definitionFit: An off day is a day when someone performs below their usual standard.

clue.text: Cleared one ensnared by drug for adults

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

indicators.note: one is caught inside the adults-only rating

parts.note: an X-rated film is for adults only
taken as written

explanation.surface: A person was cleared of a drug charge reserved for adults.
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate is to absolve someone of blame, so exonerated means acquitted of a charge.

clue.text: Offer alien a bathroom facility

parts.note: a bid is an offer, as at auction
ET is the alien of the Spielberg film

explanation.surface: Someone offers a visiting alien use of the bathroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A bidet is a low basin in a bathroom used for washing the lower body.

clue.text: It records speed on river

parts.note: to dash is to move at speed; dash as a noun is a burst of speed
the Cam is the river that flows through Cambridge

explanation.surface: A device clocks how fast something travels along a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A dashboard camera is a device that films the road ahead as a car is driven.

clue.text: Did I guess incorrectly? It's intentionally misleading

indicators.note: incorrectly tells us the letters are put together wrongly and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether they guessed wrong because it was a deliberate trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Something disguised has had its true appearance hidden on purpose so as to deceive.

clue.text: Dodgy character turned over celebrities

indicators.note: turned over says the celebrities word is read backwards

parts.note: VIPs, very important persons, are celebrities

explanation.surface: A shady figure turns his back on the famous.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiv is British slang for a flashy petty crook who deals in black-market goods.

clue.text: Knights, perhaps, caught defecting Nazi soldiers

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
Rudolf Hess, Hitler's deputy, flew to Scotland in 1941 apparently to defect or make peace
men are soldiers, as opposed to officers

explanation.surface: Knights capture a group of Nazi soldiers who were changing sides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Knights' wants to be the medieval warriors; they are chess pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Knights are one kind of chess piece, so perhaps signals an example of the category.

clue.text: Greek character on terminus, having no small change

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: the terminus word loses the letter for small

parts.note: a terminus is the end station of a line
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing

explanation.surface: A Greek man at the end of the line has no coins for his fare.
explanation.definitionFit: A mutation is an alteration in form or genes, so it is a kind of change.

clue.text: Bear was very loud during short life

indicators.note: the loud letters come during the short life, so they go inside it

parts.note: bio is a short form of biography, a written life
ff (fortissimo) is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: A bear made a great deal of noise in its brief life.
explanation.walkthrough: Biffo the Bear is a long-running character in the British children's comic The Beano.
explanation.definitionFit: The comic-strip character Biffo is a bear, so the definition names the species of the cartoon figure.

clue.text: Rebellious daughter isn't concealing viewpoint

parts.note: D is the standard abbreviation for daughter in family trees

indicators.note: the contraction hides the viewpoint word within its letters

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe
a side is one point of view in an argument

explanation.surface: A defiant daughter refuses to hide her opinion.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissident opposes official policy, so the adjective describes someone rebellious against authority.

clue.text: Abandon computer studies completely? I don't believe you

parts.note: to abandon something is to leave it
IT, information technology, is the school subject of computing
out can mean completely, as in tired out

explanation.surface: A student is told to give up computing for good and responds with disbelief.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave it out is British slang said to someone you think is lying or exaggerating, meaning come off it.

clue.text: Model order obeyed by well-disciplined setter?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to pose for an artist as a model does
second meaning: the command given to a dog such as a setter

explanation.walkthrough: The 'setter' looks like the crossword compiler, but it is the dog breed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word works as the verb for posing for a portrait and as the command a trained dog obeys.

clue.text: Work against producing token performance

parts.note: a counter is a token used in board games
an act is a performance on stage

explanation.surface: A merely token performance undermines the effort.
explanation.definitionFit: To counteract something is to oppose it and neutralise its effect.

clue.text: A sober lover left devastated by this music

indicators.note: devastated means wrecked, so these letters are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A teetotal lover is left heartbroken by a piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange A SOBER LOVER with L to give the title.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravel's Bolero is a famous orchestral piece by the French composer Maurice Ravel.

clue.text: It rearranges soil when the marrow is loosened

indicators.note: a thing loosened falls apart, so the letters come free and rearrange

explanation.surface: A gardener's marrow is pulled free, disturbing the soil.
explanation.definitionFit: An earthworm burrows through earth, mixing and aerating the soil as it moves.

clue.text: He takes on themes known to experienced types?

indicators.note: the word He is taken on board within the themes word

parts.note: tropes are recurring themes or motifs

explanation.surface: A writer adopts themes familiar to seasoned readers.
explanation.definitionFit: Experienced people know the ropes, the idiom for understanding how things work.

clue.text: Slowly introduce prayer for dead fellow involved in action

indicators.note: the prayer and fellow are involved in the action, set inside it

parts.note: a deed is an action
RIP, requiescat in pace, is the prayer for the dead

explanation.surface: A dead man's memorial prayer is introduced gradually during a ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: To drip-feed something is to supply it gradually, a little at a time.

clue.text: Reading short review describing negotiations

indicators.note: to review is to view again, so the letters are looked at afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: A brief critique describes a round of talks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reading' looks like the town or an act of reading; it is just letters, rearranged with SHORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Horse-trading is shrewd, hard bargaining, the give and take of negotiations.

clue.text: Online distortion for current movement that may be climate-changing

definitions.text: current movement that may be climate-changing

indicators.note: distortion signals the letters are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: Internet misinformation about climate science is spreading.
explanation.definitionFit: El Nino is a periodic warming of Pacific Ocean currents that disrupts weather worldwide.

clue.text: Tenor, out of practice, is however reliable

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for tenor in choral music
rusty means out of practice

explanation.surface: A singer who hasn't practised is still dependable.
explanation.definitionFit: Trusty is an old-fashioned word for dependable and faithful, as in trusty steed.

clue.text: Criticise musical style with standard backing

indicators.note: backing means the standard word is read from the back

parts.note: par is the standard, as in up to par

explanation.surface: Someone attacks a style of music for its ordinary backing track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'musical style' is a second definition: rap is a genre of music.
explanation.definitionFit: To rap someone is to rebuke them sharply, as in a rap on the knuckles.

clue.text: University head taking risk with rollover

parts.note: a chance is a risk, as in take a chance
roll over: the word roll turned over, read backwards

explanation.surface: A vice-chancellor gambles by letting a debt or lottery prize roll over.
explanation.definitionFit: In British universities the chancellor is the titular head, a ceremonial figure above the vice-chancellor.

clue.text: Family member that is immersed in new church

indicators.note: the that-is letters are immersed, sunk inside the other two pieces

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A relative is baptised by full immersion at a new church.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece is the daughter of a sibling, a female relation.

clue.text: You often get aches, when starting these exercises

indicators.note: the starting letters of these words are taken

explanation.surface: Starting a new exercise routine often leaves you aching.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoga is a discipline of stretching postures and breathing practised as physical exercise.

clue.text: Her poem on change may be arousing for others

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of these letters

explanation.surface: A poet revises her love poem so that readers find it stimulating.
explanation.definitionFit: A pheromone is a chemical signal released by an animal that triggers responses, including sexual attraction, in others.

clue.text: Pop turned back as I entered to say goodbye

indicators.note: the I has entered the reversed word, so it sits inside it
turned back says the word for pop is read backwards

parts.note: pop is a fizzy drink, soda

explanation.surface: Dad turned round when someone came in to say farewell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop' wants to be father; it is the drink. SODA reversed is ADOS, and I goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Adios is the Spanish farewell, used in English as a casual way of saying goodbye.

clue.text: Smart card contains expensive piece

indicators.note: the card word holds the other word within it

parts.note: a SIM is the smart card in a mobile phone
dear means expensive

explanation.surface: A smart card holds something costly.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidearm is a pistol worn at the side, and piece is slang for a handgun.

clue.text: Disorder in dingy port needs some backing

indicators.note: backing says the hidden letters are read backwards
some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A shabby harbour needs financial support to fix its chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: Entropy is the measure of randomness in a system, so in general use it means disorder or decline.
